tours.vmCreate.step1.title: Start creating a VM
tours.vmCreate.step1.description: Click Create VM to open the instance creation wizard.
tours.vmCreate.step2.title: Select an image
tours.vmCreate.step2.description: Select an OS image to boot the VM. Selecting one automatically moves to the next step.
tours.vmCreate.step3.title: Select a flavor
tours.vmCreate.step3.description: A flavor defines the VM's vCPU · memory · disk specifications. Only flavors that can be created within the project's remaining quota are shown, and the scheduler automatically selects an available host for GPU flavors. Selecting one automatically moves to the next step.
tours.vmCreate.step4.title: Library (beta)
tours.vmCreate.step4.description: This beta feature adds AI/ML library layers to a VM. Select the layers you need, or skip without selecting any by clicking "Next →".
tours.vmCreate.step5.title: Check general settings
tours.vmCreate.step5.description: Check the VM name (automatically generated if left blank), network, SSH key pair, security group, availability zone, and root disk size. You can create the VM with the defaults. When ready, click "Next →".
tours.vmCreate.step6.title: Deploy
tours.vmCreate.step6.description: Review the configuration summary one last time. Clicking "Create VM" starts deployment in this order: create boot volume → create instance.
tours.vmCreate.step7.title: Deployment complete
tours.vmCreate.step7.description: After deployment, you return to the dashboard. Check that the new VM appears at the top of the recent instances list. Click its name to open the details.
tours.volume.step1.title: Open volume creation
tours.volume.step1.description: Click + Create volume to open the creation form.
tours.volume.step2.title: Enter volume details
tours.volume.step2.description: Enter the volume name and size (GB), then click "Create". The button is enabled after you enter a name.
tours.volume.step3.title: Manage volumes
tours.volume.step3.description: The new volume has been added to the list. Click its row to open the detail panel, or use the action menu on the right to extend·attach to an instance·delete it.
tours.drover.step1.title: Open cluster creation
tours.drover.step1.description: Click + Create cluster to open the Drover cluster creation form.
tours.drover.step2.title: Cluster name
tours.drover.step2.description: Enter a cluster name. It is generated automatically if left blank.
tours.drover.step3.title: OS type
tours.drover.step3.description: Select the node OS. Click Ubuntu (cloud-init) or CoreOS (Ignition) to continue.
tours.drover.step4.title: Master count
tours.drover.step4.description: Select the control plane configuration. Click 1 (single) or 3 (HA — embedded etcd, API LB created automatically) to continue.
tours.drover.step5.title: Agent count
tours.drover.step5.description: Enter a worker (agent) node count between 0~10.
tours.drover.step6.title: Agent flavor
tours.drover.step6.description: Select the VM specifications for agent nodes. You can leave "Use defaults" selected.
tours.drover.step7.title: Create cluster
tours.drover.step7.description: Clicking "Create" starts VM provisioning and k3s installation.
tours.drover.step8.title: Provisioning progress
tours.drover.step8.description: Progress is shown in real time in this order: create VM → install k3s → complete. When finished, click Close, then download kubeconfig from the list card to connect immediately with kubectl.
tours.adminCompute.step1.title: Compute overview
tours.adminCompute.step1.description: Explore VM status across all projects and administrator query tools. This tour does not create VMs or run bulk actions.
tours.adminCompute.step2.title: Narrow the scope
tours.adminCompute.step2.description: Narrow down instances to investigate with host·project·status·name filters. Changing filters only queries data.
tours.adminCompute.step3.title: Check changes
tours.adminCompute.step3.description: Compare ACTIVE·SHUTOFF·ERROR·SHELVED changes in instance count trends over time.
tours.adminCompute.step4.title: All instances
tours.adminCompute.step4.description: Check project·flavor·host·status. Do not click the bulk start·stop·delete actions below the checkboxes.
tours.adminCompute.step5.title: Open instance details
tours.adminCompute.step5.description: Click the name to open the read-only detail panel.
tours.adminCompute.step6.title: Check details
tours.adminCompute.step6.description: Check general information·network·storage·metrics. Do not click actions such as start·stop·delete; close the panel when finished.
tours.adminStorage.step1.title: Storage overview
tours.adminStorage.step1.description: Safely explore volume trends·status·lists across all projects.
tours.adminStorage.step2.title: Check capacity changes
tours.adminStorage.step2.description: Compare total·in-use·available·error volume counts over time.
tours.adminStorage.step3.title: Status distribution
tours.adminStorage.step3.description: Status cards show counts alongside the current filter.
tours.adminStorage.step4.title: Show available volumes only
tours.adminStorage.step4.description: Click the available card to see the status filter applied to the list. This only runs the query again.
tours.adminStorage.step5.title: Search by project and name
tours.adminStorage.step5.description: Narrow the investigation further by project·status·name.
tours.adminStorage.step6.title: All volumes
tours.adminStorage.step6.description: Read size·project·creation date. Do not click edit·transfer·change status·delete in the action menu on the right.
tours.adminStorage.step7.title: Open volume details
tours.adminStorage.step7.description: Click the name to open the read-only detail panel.
tours.adminStorage.step8.title: Check volume configuration
tours.adminStorage.step8.description: Check type·attachments·metadata. Do not run change·recovery actions; close the panel when finished.
tours.adminLibrary.step1.title: Palimpsest Dockerfile workspace
tours.adminLibrary.step1.description: Explore the flow and existing records for building full roots and changed layers from Dockerfiles and optionally creating SSH VMs.
tours.adminLibrary.step2.title: Dockerfile builds and SSH VMs
tours.adminLibrary.step2.description: Import a Dockerfile from direct input·URL·file·pinned GitHub commit, then check lint·plans·job records·VM execution targets.
tours.adminLibrary.step3.title: Profile records
tours.adminLibrary.step3.description: Check profiles created by Dockerfile builds and the lineage·visibility of existing profiles. Do not save·publish·delete.
tours.adminLibrary.step4.title: Artifact overview
tours.adminLibrary.step4.description: Read sealing·visibility status, inheritance chains, requested packages, and reasons deletion is blocked.
tours.adminLibrary.step5.title: Build overview
tours.adminLibrary.step5.description: Check the build pipeline by type·stage·progress·completion status.
tours.adminLibrary.step6.title: Consumer instances
tours.adminLibrary.step6.description: Check the status and creation time of consumer VMs using a profile. Do not create·delete.
tours.adminNetwork.step1.title: All network connections
tours.adminNetwork.step1.description: Explore connections between networks·routers·VMs·Floating IPs·load balancers across projects.
tours.adminNetwork.step2.title: Narrow the scope by project
tours.adminNetwork.step2.description: Selecting a project only narrows the topology display.
tours.adminNetwork.step3.title: Read the topology
tours.adminNetwork.step3.description: Read search·traffic values·network zones (lanes) together with connection lines.
tours.adminNetwork.step4.title: Open router details
tours.adminNetwork.step4.description: Click a router card to open read-only details.
tours.adminNetwork.step5.title: Gateway and interfaces
tours.adminNetwork.step5.description: Check the external gateway and connected subnets, then click × Close to continue.
tours.adminNetwork.step6.title: Legend and resource counts
tours.adminNetwork.step6.description: Check the symbols·connection lines in the legend and the network·router·instance·Floating IP·load balancer counts at the bottom.
tours.adminContainers.step1.title: All containers
tours.adminContainers.step1.description: Explore container status·image·resources·host across all projects.
tours.adminContainers.step2.title: Read the container list
tours.adminContainers.step3.title: Open container details
tours.adminContainers.step3.description: Click a row to open the read-only detail panel.
tours.adminContainers.step4.title: Configuration and network
tours.adminContainers.step4.description: Check general information and addresses. Do not click start·stop·delete, as these change resources.
tours.adminContainers.step5.title: Check logs
tours.adminContainers.step5.description: Open the logs section to view output only. Close the panel when finished.
tours.adminKeyManager.step1.title: Key Manager quotas
tours.adminKeyManager.step2.title: Read quota values
tours.adminKeyManager.step2.description: Check Secrets·Orders·Containers values and project IDs. -1 means unlimited; 0 means disabled.
tours.adminKeyManager.step3.title: Distinguish change actions
tours.adminKeyManager.step3.description: Set and reset are PUT·DELETE operations that change data, so do not click them in this tutorial.
tours.adminMonitoring.step1.title: Unified monitoring
tours.adminMonitoring.step1.description: Explore the cluster summary and instance metrics in read-only mode.
tours.adminMonitoring.step2.title: Cluster summary
tours.adminMonitoring.step2.description: Check Compute·storage·network·containers·data services·Identity status at a glance.
tours.adminMonitoring.step3.title: Instance metrics tab
tours.adminMonitoring.step3.description: Click the tab to open the list of instances across all projects.
tours.adminMonitoring.step4.title: Search instances
tours.adminMonitoring.step4.description: Narrow the list by name or project ID.
tours.adminMonitoring.step5.title: Open metric details
tours.adminMonitoring.step5.description: Click a row to open the read-only metrics panel.
tours.adminMonitoring.step6.title: Read time series
tours.adminMonitoring.step6.description: Check CPU·memory·network·disk time series, plus GPU time series when a GPU is present. Only change the query interval.
tours.adminSystem.step1.title: Service status
tours.adminSystem.step1.description: Read processes by service category, endpoints, and storage pools.
tours.adminSystem.step2.title: Switch categories
tours.adminSystem.step2.description: Check counts and loading status for services such as Compute·Network·Block Storage.
tours.adminSystem.step3.title: Network agents
tours.adminSystem.step3.description: Click the tab to check Agent Type·Binary·Host·Zone·Alive·Admin State.
tours.adminSystem.step4.title: Read status rows
tours.adminSystem.step4.description: Distinguish up·enabled from down·disabled, and check change times and reasons for disabling.
tours.adminSystem.step5.title: API endpoints
tours.adminSystem.step5.description: Check public·internal·admin URLs by service and region.
tours.adminSystem.step6.title: Endpoint interfaces
tours.adminSystem.step6.description: Check that the interface URLs for the same service point to the correct region.
tours.adminSystem.step7.title: Storage pools
tours.adminSystem.step8.title: Read capacity
tours.adminIdentity.step1.title: Identity user management
tours.adminIdentity.step1.description: Safely explore user summaries·recent changes·search·filters·lists. Do not create or edit.
tours.adminIdentity.step2.title: User overview
tours.adminIdentity.step2.description: Read total·active·inactive counts alongside recent user change logs.
tours.adminIdentity.step3.title: Search and sort
tours.adminIdentity.step3.description: Narrow the list by name·email search, active status, and sorting by name·first activity date.
tours.adminIdentity.step4.title: Show active users only
tours.adminIdentity.step4.description: Selecting active status only changes the client-side list; it does not change user accounts.
tours.adminIdentity.step5.title: User list
tours.adminIdentity.step6.title: Details and session entry points
tours.adminIdentity.step6.description: Clicking a row opens the edit form and session management. In this safe tour, do not click rows·active toggles·save·revoke sessions.
tours.waygate.step1.description: Only Waygate servers in the currently selected project are shown. Switching projects also resets details and selection.
tours.waygate.step2.title: Server list
tours.waygate.step2.description: Check server status and client counts. Click a row to open details.
